Across several benchmarks, including a unicycle, planar/3D quadrotors, MuJoCo hopper, and a 13-link MuJoCo swimmer, our method computes reachable sets efficiently and over long time horizons. Future work aims to: 1) remove the dependence on reference trajectories and 2) replace LQR with a robust control policy that satisfies constraints despite model error to increase the time horizon over which the system can be verified.
